data.title: 椎名真昼 · 床头换好的温热毛巾
data.description: 真昼穿薄荷绿开衫和灰色家居长裤，坐在床边把折好的温热毛巾放到床头托盘。她用指背试了试温度，确认合适后向画面外轻轻点头；亚麻金长发束到肩后，关切的神情安静而踏实。
data.action: 坐在床边，用指背轻贴托盘上的温热毛巾，向画外的人轻轻点头
data.promptProse: Seated gently at the edge of the bedroom bed in the evening wearing her soft sage-mint cashmere cardigan over wide grey lounge trousers, Mahiru keeps her long flaxen hair gathered neatly behind her shoulder. Resting a freshly folded warm towel onto the small tray beside the bed, she tests its warmth lightly with the backs of her fingers before nodding softly toward the off-frame viewer with quiet, reassuring care. Dim warm bedside lamplight softens the bedroom linens and her tender gaze.
data.animaCaption: Seated at the bed edge in her soft mint cashmere cardigan, Mahiru tests the warmth of a folded towel on the bedside tray with the backs of her fingers and nods gently toward the viewer. Warm evening lamplight illuminates her quiet, caring expression.
